reviews.title: Basics doesn’t work
reviews.text: Type numbers quickly. Half the numbers don’t even appear. The most basic thing of a calculator or currency converter. Just try it yourself. Type 1234 and it’ll only show 1 or 14

reviews.title: Seems very shady to me
reviews.text: It seems very shady that the app does not have (or makes it difficult to find) account settings in the app itself. I tried to cancel my 1-week-free then $19.99 per year subscription, but I cannot find “account,” “subscription,” or “cancellation” in the app.

reviews.title: Needs Updating
reviews.text: The data entry part of numbers is not visible using iPhone 13 Pro Max although it states ‘liquid glass’, not everyone chooses  liquid glass!!! You can’t use same color of button as the background, just common sense!!!

reviews.title: Unreadable keypad
reviews.text: It’s impossible to read the keys to type in numbers unless my iPhone is in dark mode

reviews.title: Porn ad?!!
reviews.text: I randomly opened my app at work and found ad with porn in it!!!

reviews.title: Stopped working
reviews.text: This was a great app. No longer. The problem: the numbers on the keypad one would use to change the amount being converted are invisible. This means the app is only useful to show exchange rates. It is useless if you are trying to figure out how much  you paid for dinner, etc.

reviews.title: Ads not suitable for children
reviews.text: The ads displayed at the bottom sometimes are not suitable for children. Eg today it was an ad for temu with disgusting adult toys.

reviews.title: Stopped working with iOS 26
reviews.text: Had it for years but when I had to upgrade to iOS 26 it no longer works. When I open the app there’s no numbers on the buttons. I deleted the app and reinstalled it but it still doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Time to switch away from this!
reviews.text: The most recent 'update' looks like it was designed by a child!  You had a perfectly good app, and now it looks like a child's toy.  We want currency information, not a dazzling color display that is impossible to comprehend!  Worst app update of any app EVER!

reviews.title: Not accurate
reviews.text: Not accurate and not daily updated rates.
